criteria.name: distinctiveness
criteria.description: Each character has a specific combination of traits that makes them feel like a real individual, not a generic archetype. No two characters feel interchangeable.

criteria.name: internal_consistency
criteria.description: Each character's role, backstory, goal, and flaw are coherent — they fit together and no element contradicts another.

criteria.name: dramatic_utility
criteria.description: Characters' flaws and goals would generate interesting conflict and story moments. None are passive or consequence-free.

criteria.name: voice_specificity
criteria.description: Speech patterns and personality traits are concrete enough that a writer could produce distinct dialogue for each character without guessing.
